# Pipeline

```{python}
#| include: false
by_status = q("select status, count(*) as n from marts.fct_snapshot_hours group by status")
by_status = dict(zip(by_status.status, by_status.n, strict=True))
hwm = q("select logical_hour as h from marts.fct_snapshot_hours where is_high_water_mark").h[0]
unobservable = int(q("select count(*) as n from marts.dim_game where is_unobservable").n[0])
```

## Row

::: {.valuebox icon="flag" color="dark"}
High-water mark, `{python} f"{hwm:%Y-%m-%d}"` UTC

`{python} f"{hwm:%H:%M}"`
:::

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Hours complete"
{"icon": "check-circle", "value": int(by_status.get("complete", 0))}
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Hours the warehouse heard nothing"
unrecorded = int(by_status.get("unrecorded", 0))
{"icon": "x-circle", "value": unrecorded, "color": "danger" if unrecorded else "light"}
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Games Steam publishes no count for"
{"icon": "eye-slash", "value": unobservable}
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Every hour since the first observation, by status (UTC)"
status_grid(
  q("""
    select
      (logical_hour at time zone 'utc')::date as day,
      extract(hour from logical_hour at time zone 'utc')::int as hour,
      status,
      status || coalesce(
        ': ' || observed_count || ' of ' || tracked_count || ' observed', ''
      ) as hover
    from marts.fct_snapshot_hours
  """)
)
```

## Row

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Games observed per hour"
lines(
  q("""
    select logical_hour, snapshot_rows
    from marts.fct_snapshot_hours
    order by 1
  """),
  x="logical_hour",
  ys=["snapshot_rows"],
  names=["Games"],
)
```

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Steam call latency per hour, milliseconds log scale"
lines(
  q("select logical_hour, latency_p50_ms, latency_max_ms from marts.fct_snapshot_hours order by 1"),
  x="logical_hour",
  ys=["latency_p50_ms", "latency_max_ms"],
  names=["Median", "Max"],
  log_y=True,
)
```
